title: A Device class
hints: In __init__ assign to self.<name> for each parameter; normalise hostname with .strip().lower() there so every other method can trust it.
In __repr__ use an f-string with {self.hostname!r}; the !r adds the quotes around strings and leaves ints bare.
__eq__ should start with `if not isinstance(other, Device): return NotImplemented`, then compare serials. __hash__ returns hash(self.serial) so equal objects hash the same.
